create_iterable_dataset_from_generator: create an iterable dataset from a Python generator function that yields example dictionaries
load_iterable_dataset_from_parquet: load an iterable dataset from one or more Parquet files with optional column selection and filters
map_transform_iterable_dataset: apply a transformation function to all examples in an iterable dataset on the fly during iteration
shuffle_and_filter_iterable_dataset: shuffle an iterable dataset with a buffer and filter examples using a predicate function
push_iterable_dataset_to_hub: push an iterable dataset to the Hugging Face Hub as self-contained Parquet files with optional multiprocessing
